name: tiro
title: Tiro
description: Search notes with a Tiro account and control recordings in the separately installed Tiro desktop app (4.12.1+).
author: paul-theplato

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.subtitle: Tiro
commands.description: Search your Tiro notes and read summaries and transcripts.

commands.name: start-live-note
commands.title: Start Live Note
commands.subtitle: Tiro
commands.description: Start a new live note in the Tiro desktop app.

commands.name: end-live-note
commands.title: End Live Note and Create Document
commands.subtitle: Tiro
commands.description: End the current live note and create its document. Requires Tiro desktop 4.12.1 or later.

commands.name: start-offline-recording
commands.title: Start Offline Recording
commands.subtitle: Tiro
commands.description: Start a new offline recording in the Tiro desktop app.

commands.name: end-offline-recording
commands.title: End and Upload Offline Recording
commands.subtitle: Tiro
commands.description: End and upload the current offline recording. Does not end a live note. Requires the latest Tiro desktop app.

tools.name: search-notes
tools.title: Search Notes
tools.description: Search Tiro notes by keyword, or list the most recent notes when no keyword is given.

tools.name: get-note
tools.title: Get Note
tools.description: Get a Tiro note's summary and, when asked, its speaker-attributed transcript.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Paste an account API key from tiro.ooo/platform/me/api-keys to use it instead of signing in.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
scripts.test: node scripts/test-recording-links.mjs && node scripts/test-format.mjs && node scripts/test-note-actions.mjs
